subject.title: Message plugin: support Telegram forum topic management (create/edit/close/reopen)

question: Should the shared message tool expose destructive Telegram topic deletion, and if so, should it be a distinct `topic-delete` action with its own Telegram action gate rather than overloading message deletion?
rationale: Closing and reopening follow the existing topic-management pattern, but deletion removes a topic and its messages; repository policy requires an explicit decision before adding a destructive fallback or public action contract.

options.title: Adopt explicit lifecycle actions
options.body: Add separate close, reopen, and delete topic actions, with deletion independently named, gated, documented, and covered by destructive-operation tests.

options.title: Ship reversible operations first
options.body: Add close and reopen now while deferring topic deletion until maintainers choose its safety and operator contract.

options.title: Keep topic management limited
options.body: Retain the existing create/edit support and leave lifecycle closure/deletion outside the shared message tool.

recommendation.title: Adopt explicit lifecycle actions
recommendation.body: Add separate close, reopen, and delete topic actions, with deletion independently named, gated, documented, and covered by destructive-operation tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant shared action and Telegram runtime surfaces trace to Vincent Koc's current-main feature work.
